name: Black Blood
body:
School necromancy [poison]; Level alchemist 6

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 10 minutes/level

DESCRIPTION

As poison, except that creatures that hit you with natural or unarmed attacks are affected as by the poison spell.
